services.name: frontend
services.description: Exposes an HTTP server to serve the website. Calls recommendation, cart, checkout, catalog, and ad services.

services.name: checkoutservice
services.description: Orchestrates order placement. Coordinates cartservice, paymentservice, and productcatalogservice.

services.name: cartservice
services.description: Stores user cart items in Redis memory store.

services.name: recommendationservice
services.description: Provides product recommendations based on items in user's cart.

services.name: paymentservice
services.description: Charges credit card info via third-party payment gateway.

services.name: productcatalogservice
services.description: Provides list of products and queries product database.

services.name: adservice
services.description: Provides text ads displayed on pages based on context.
